{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent sentiment turns negative (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 with no prior positive signal).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is positive (e.g., +0.50) and price is trending upward — avoid overconfidence.",
    "Lag correction: if true outcome is below forecast by >10% for 3+ consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 5-8%.",
    "Avoid overreacting to early sentiment shifts — delay correction until 2-3 days after sentiment change.",
    "When sentiment is consistently 0.00, use historical 30-day mean as baseline, with ±3% volatility buffer."
  ]
}
